Vectra Privacy Policy

Last updated 8 November 2026

In short: Vectra keeps your account and your timetable so they sync between devices. It doesn't show ads, doesn't use analytics or tracking, and never sells or shares your data for marketing. You can delete your account and everything in it from Settings at any time.

Who is responsible

Vectra is an independent app made by one developer (southstar21). It isn't run by your university, by Neptun's developer or by BKK. For anything about your data, email support@southstar21.dev.

What Vectra stores

These are kept on the Vectra server, tied to your account, for as long as the account exists:

  • Account: your email address, the nickname you choose, and your password (stored only as a secure hash). If you add a passkey, its public key and a name for it.
  • Timetable: your Neptun calendar link, the classes and exams from it, classes you add yourself, and your shifts and tasks. Course names, rooms and instructors are encrypted before they're stored.
  • Course tracker: attendance, grades, points and each course's rules.
  • Transit and settings: the lines and stops you track, and your app preferences.

We use this data only to run the app: to show your schedule, keep it in sync and work out breaks, clashes and how many classes you can still skip.

Location

Vectra asks for your location only while you're using it, and only if you allow it. It's used to find stops and departures near you and to show local weather. Your coordinates go out with those requests (see below) but are not stored on the Vectra server or tied to your account. You can turn location off in your phone's settings and the rest of the app keeps working.

Services Vectra talks to

Some features need data from other services. Each one receives only what it needs for that request, and, like any website, sees your device's IP address.

ServiceWhat forWhat it receives
Google Apps ScriptDownloading your Neptun calendar (the university's servers block many networks, Google's are allowed)Your Neptun calendar link
BKK Futár, through the Vectra serverDepartures, vehicles, routes and service alertsStops, lines and, for nearby stops, your location
Open-MeteoWeather and forecastYour approximate location
BigDataCloudThe name of the place you're in, for the weather cardYour approximate location
RainViewerRain radarWhich map area is on screen
OpenFreeMapMap tilesWhich map area is on screen

There are no advertising, analytics or crash-reporting services in the app. Vectra doesn't sell your data or share it with anyone for marketing.

Security

All traffic is encrypted (HTTPS). Sensitive timetable fields are encrypted on the server, and your sign-in token on the phone is kept in the system's secure storage. The server keeps short-lived technical records, such as request counts per IP address, to stop abuse.

How long data is kept, and deleting it

Your data stays as long as your account does. To delete it, open Settings → About → Delete account in the app. Your account and everything in it is removed straight away and can't be recovered. If you can't sign in any more, email support@southstar21.dev from your account's address and we'll delete it for you. Signing out removes the copy on your phone.

Your rights

If you're in the EU (Vectra is made in Hungary), the GDPR lets you see a copy of your data, have it corrected or deleted, get it in a portable format, and object to or restrict how it's used. The legal basis is that we need this data to provide the service you signed up for. Email support@southstar21.dev to use any of these rights. You can also complain to the Hungarian data protection authority, NAIH, or the authority where you live.

Children

Vectra is made for university students and isn't meant for children under 16.

Changes

If this policy changes, the new version is posted here with a new date.
